diffs.diff: pin count: part has 9 (VIN 3Vo GND SCL SDA DO CS I1 I2), datasheet reading has 14 (VIN 3Vo GND SCL SDA DO CS I1 I2 SCX SDX CS DO GND)
diffs.evidence: Adafruit pinout guide lists the bottom 9-pin header (Vin, 3Vo, GND, SCL, SDA, DO, CS, INT1, INT2) and separately: 'SCX, SDX, Aux CS, DO (Top) - Pins for advanced users to connect the LSM6DSOX, ISM330DHCX, or LSM6DSO32 to another sensor.' The 5-pin top row is the sensor-hub/auxiliary interface, not needed for basic I2C use; the model deliberately models only the 9-pin main header (1x09 footprint) and its description states '5-pin auxiliary SCX, SDX, CS, DO, GND header not modelled'. The 9 modelled pins and their order match the guide.

diffs.diff: acceleration_mg: datasheet reading gives 0.061 per count, the part's model has 0.003906, 0.00875, 0.00875, 0.00875, 0.000061, 0.000061, 0.000061
diffs.evidence: ST driver ism330dhcx_reg.c: 'float_t ism330dhcx_from_fs2g_to_mg(int16_t lsb) { return ((float_t)lsb * 0.061f); }'. The model's accel registers 0x28/0x2A/0x2C use scale 0.000061 in g per LSB (controls unit 'g'), which equals 0.061 mg/LSB - same value, different unit. The driver also uses 0.061e-3 g/LSB at +-2 g. (0.003906 is the temperature channel, 1/256 degC/LSB; 0.00875 is the gyro channel.)

diffs.diff: angular_rate_mdps: datasheet reading gives 8.75 per count, the part's model has 0.003906, 0.00875, 0.00875, 0.00875, 0.000061, 0.000061, 0.000061
diffs.evidence: ST driver ism330dhcx_reg.c: 'float_t ism330dhcx_from_fs250dps_to_mdps(int16_t lsb) { return ((float_t)lsb * 8.75f); }'. The model's gyro registers 0x22/0x24/0x26 use scale 0.00875 in dps per LSB (controls unit 'dps'), which equals 8.75 mdps/LSB - same value, different unit. The driver uses 8.75e-3 dps/LSB at +-250 dps.
